import pytest
from your_module import rgb_to_hex  # replace with actual module name

class TestRgbToHex:
    # Happy path
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "r, g, b, expected",
        [
            (255, 255, 255, "#ffffff"),
            (0, 0, 0, "#000000"),
            (128, 128, 128, "#808080"),
            (10, 20, 30, "#0a141e"),
            (15, 16, 17, "#0f1011"),
            (240, 248, 255, "#f0f8ff"),  # aliceblue
        ],
    )
    def test_valid_colors(self, r, g, b, expected):
        assert rgb_to_hex(r, g, b) == expected

    # Edge cases: boundaries and single-digit hex padding
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "r, g, b, expected",
        [
            (0, 0, 0, "#000000"),
            (255, 255, 255, "#ffffff"),
            (0, 255, 0, "#00ff00"),
            (255, 0, 0, "#ff0000"),
            (0, 0, 255, "#0000ff"),
            (1, 1, 1, "#010101"),
            (254, 254, 254, "#fefefe"),
            (16, 16, 16, "#101010"),
            (17, 17, 17, "#111111"),
        ],
    )
    def test_boundary_and_padding(self, r, g, b, expected):
        assert rgb_to_hex(r, g, b) == expected

    # Error cases: out-of-range integers
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "r, g, b",
        [
            (-1, 0, 0),
            (0, -1, 0),
            (0, 0, -1),
            (256, 0, 0),
            (0, 256, 0),
            (0, 0, 256),
            (-1, -1, -1),
            (256, 256, 256),
            (300, 0, 0),
            (0, 0, -255),
        ],
    )
    def test_out_of_range_raises_valueerror(self, r, g, b):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="RGB values must be 0-255"):
            rgb_to_hex(r, g, b)

    # Error cases: non-integer types
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "r, g, b",
        [
            (1.5, 0, 0),          # float in range but not int
            (0, "128", 0),        # string
            (None, 0, 0),         # None
            ([255], 0, 0),        # list
            (0, 0, (255,)),       # tuple
        ],
    )
    def test_invalid_types_raise_exception(self, r, g, b):
        # The function may raise ValueError or TypeError depending on the input.
        # We simply verify that an exception is raised.
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            rgb_to_hex(r, g, b)
